correctness.rationale: The unique five-digram set {00,01,02,10,20} is proved from substitution boundaries. Every length-4d factor for 1<=d<=1705 lies in one of the five genuine adjacent level-16 image pairs at an offset within the first image because min image length=10609>6820. Therefore exhaustive scan of these 5 finite covers is equivalent to the infinite factor-existence condition. Exact prefix-symbol count identities characterize both four-power predicates. The complete 1705+1705 membership rows, all positive witnesses, and independent minimal-sufficient-level rescans were verified by the included standalone script, yielding 579 additive, 462 Abelian, 117 additive-only and first difference d=10. No larger orders are claimed.
